This [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was<ref name="TCW" /> a '''chorus girl'''<ref name="Hunt for Ziro Old EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCW" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|309}}</ref> she performed for the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Grand Council]] in [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla's]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|Palace]] with two other Twi'leks and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] during a visit by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TCW" />
